name: Antusuchus
sum: Antusuchus is a small terrestrial peirosaurid notosuchian with blade-like serrated teeth from the Candeleros Formation of Río Negro, Argentina.
wsnote: Skull about 11.5 cm long, about half that of Montealtosuchus (English Wikipedia); maturity unclear; no body length.
holotype: MPCA PV 1294, an articulated skull and lower jaw.
biology: Probably carnivorous; two individuals found together hint at group living (English Wikipedia).
author: Fernández-Dumont et al. 2026

sources.text: Fernández-Dumont, M. L., Apesteguía, S., Pol, D., Bona, P., Pérez Mayoral, J. and Vega, N. 2026. A new early peirosaurid terrestrial crocodile (Notosuchia) from La Buitrera (Candeleros Formation), Río Negro, Argentina. Historical Biology.

dates_note: No PBDB occurrences. Albian (about 111-106 Ma) per the English Wikipedia infobox and lead; its body text says Cenomanian, so the page is inconsistent.
